skill.name: CLAUDE.md - Next.js App Router 项目规范
skill.domain: # CLAUDE.md - Next.js App Router 项目规范 ## 项目结构 - 使用 Next.js App Router（`app/` 目录），不使用 Pages Router - 目录约定： - `app/` - 路由与页面 - `components/` - 可复用组件，按功能分子目录（`components/ui/`、`components/layout/`） - `lib/` - 工具函数、API 客户端、数据库操作 - `types/` - 全局类型定义 - `public/` - 静态资源 ## Server / Client 组件 - 只在需要交互、浏览器 API、hooks 时才加 `'use client'` - Server Component 中直接 `await` 异步数据，不需要 `useEffect` + `useState` - 将交互逻辑拆分为小的 Client Component，嵌入 Server Component 中，最小化客户端 bundle ## 数据获取 - Server Component 中直接调用数据库或内部 API，不经过 HTTP - 使用 `fetch()` 时利用 Next.js 内置缓存：`fetch(url, { next: { revalidate: 3600 } })` - 需要实时数据时用 `{ cache: 'no-store' }` 或在 layout/page 中 `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` - 变更操作使用 Server Actions（`'use server'` 函数），配合 `revalidatePath()` / `revalidateTag()` 刷新缓存 - 表单提交优先用 `<form action={serverAction}>`，客户端补充用 `useFormStatus` 和 `useActionState` ## API Routes - API 路由放在 `app/api/` 下，导出 `GET`、`POST` 等命名函数 - 使用 `NextRequest` / `NextResponse` 类型 - 返回数据统一格式：`{ data, error, message }` - 鉴权中间件写在 `middleware.ts`（项目根目录），匹配 `config.matcher` ## 样式 - 使用 Tailwind CSS，不写自定义 CSS 文件除非绝对必要 - 组件样式用 Tailwind utility class 直接写在 JSX 中 - 复杂样式组合用 `clsx` 或 `cn`（`lib/utils.ts` 中封装 `twMerge + clsx`） - 响应式断点顺序：`sm:` > `md:` > `lg:` > `xl:`，移动端优先 ## TypeScript 规范 - 开启 strict 模式，禁止 `any` - 页面 props 类型用 Next.js 内置泛型：`type Props = { params: Promise<{ slug: string

tasks.prompt: Configure the root app/layout.tsx to set page metadata title and description using Next.js's built-in metadata API.
tasks.criterion: Root layout exports a valid metadata object with title and description, uses the built-in metadata API correctly.

tasks.prompt: Create a contact form in app/contact/page.tsx that uses <form action={serverAction}> for submission and useActionState for client-side validation.
tasks.criterion: Form uses the specified Server Action submission pattern, uses useActionState for validation, no manual fetch calls for submission.

tasks.prompt: Write a date formatting utility function in lib/utils.ts that converts a date string to a localized readable format, and export it for app-wide use.
tasks.criterion: Utility exists in lib/utils.ts, formats dates to localized readable format, is properly exported.

tasks.prompt: Create an API route at app/api/users/route.ts with a GET function that returns user data in { data, error, message } format using NextRequest/NextResponse.
tasks.criterion: Route is in the correct path, exports GET function, uses correct types, returns data in the specified uniform format.

tasks.prompt: Implement a 'use server' marked Server Action in lib/actions.ts that updates a user profile and calls revalidatePath('/dashboard') after success.
tasks.criterion: Action is marked 'use server', updates profile data, calls revalidatePath for the correct path post-success.

tasks.prompt: Add a BlogPost type definition in types/index.ts with id, title, content, createdAt, authorId fields, all using strict TypeScript types with no any.
tasks.criterion: BlogPost type is in the correct file, includes all required fields with strict types, no any types used.

tasks.prompt: Build a Client Component modal in components/ui/Modal.tsx that accepts isOpen and onClose props, uses Tailwind for all styling, and renders children content.
tasks.criterion: Modal is marked 'use client', accepts required props, uses only Tailwind for styling, no custom CSS files.

tasks.prompt: Add a middleware.ts at the project root that checks for a valid auth token in headers, redirects unauthenticated users to /login, matching the /dashboard/* path pattern.
tasks.criterion: Middleware is at project root, checks auth token, redirects unauthenticated users to /login, matches the specified path in config.matcher.

tasks.prompt: Build a reusable Input component in components/ui/ that supports an error prop for validation messages, uses Tailwind classes and the cn utility for conditional styling.
tasks.criterion: Input is in the correct directory, supports error prop, uses Tailwind and cn for conditional styling, no custom CSS.

tasks.prompt: Build a reusable Card component in components/ui/ that accepts title and children props, uses Tailwind for padding, border, shadow, and the cn utility for conditional classes.
tasks.criterion: Card is in the correct directory, accepts required props, uses Tailwind for specified styling, uses cn for conditional classes, no custom CSS.
